name: malformed_null
description: Malformed JSON, non-object JSON, missing/null/invalid fields, out-of-range measurements, cell_voltage_max_v below cell_voltage_min_v, NaN, an empty line, a VIN-like vehicle_id, an impossible date, an unsupported major version and a real-looking location are routed to the error path. A valid SYN-* location and an unknown additive field are accepted but never propagated; the valid readings still produce a summary.
